page.overview:
Who is Caradryel?

Caradryel, called Caradryel the Peacemaker, was the fifth Phoenix King of Ulthuan and the one to end the War of the Beard against the Dwarfs, and inadvertently give rise to the Wood Elves of Athel Loren.

Caradryel had not been a warrior, although he was trained to fight with a sword. His main assets were the numerous friends he had made and his keen eye for politics. The seat of his family, House Reveniol, was Faer-Lyen in Yvresse.

Caradryel of House Reveniol was originally a diplomat who sought employ in the household of Imladriks wife Yethanial, after witnessing how her husband’s dragon incinerated a ship of Druchii corsairs. He did so after deducing that Imladrik would not be allowed to remain in Ulthuan, as parties critical to his brothers rule would seek to install him as ruler instead. Correctly assessing that the Lord of Dragons had little mind for politics and intrigue, Caradryel offered counsel on these dangers. Despite being turned away at first, he was contacted again after Caledor II acted as he had predicted and installed as Imladriks advisor in Tor Alessi. One of his first tasks was to arrange a parlance between Imladrik and Morgrim Bargrum, now known as Elgidum. Thanks to memorized Khazalid taught by him by the Master of Dragons, Caradryel managed to gain an audience and was allowed to travel with the dwarf host that marched to lay siege to Tor Alessi, where Morgrim would tell him his decision. During that period, he managed to observe the dwarfs up close and could assess their psychology and threat to the elves. He also watched the Council of the representatives of the colonies for attempts to undermine Imladriks effort to reestablish diplomatic contact with the dwarfs.

After Imladriks death, Caradryel served Imladriks son, Thoriol, and brought him to Lothern at the request of Caledor II. The Phoenix King, having no children of his own, hoped to groom his nephew into a successor. He then acted as an intermediate between Thoriol and his mother, hoping to use his influence to bring Thoriol to make Caledor see reason and abandon the war, focusing on Malekith instead. He organized a sizeable faction among the Asur nobility which came to oppose the war, especially since most of the dragons abandoned the conflict to enter slumber in their caves after the death of the Master of Dragons and the Elves were losing their greatest advantage. While Caledor II disliked him, he respected him for his loyalty to his House and thus made him his steward when he set out to the Old World, to hold the Phoenix Throne as regent until Thoriol returned to claim his birthright. When the seneschal of Caledor tried to assassinate him and revealed himself as an agent of Malekith, Caradryel received news that an army was sailing from Naggaroth while the armed forced of Ulthuan were concentrated at Tor Alessi. Thoriol refused to become Phoenix King, instead nominating Caradryel in his place. His arguments were that Ulthuan did not need a warrior as king, but a uniter, who would bring the different factions and divisions in the Ten Kingdoms together.
